rationale: Separate feature branches preserve history immutability and isolate functional pipelines.
Structured feature branching encapsulates changes cleanly aligned with design modules.
Trunk-based development reduces merge conflicts and keeps direct procedural execution fast.
Feature branching is compatible with declarative CI/CD and roadmap tracking configs.
Easy metadata/reflection inspection on isolated branches during rapid prototyping.
Feature branches mapped to tasks enforce rigorous quality controls and audit tracking.
Branching adds unnecessary management overhead for a small project
User ratified Feature-Task Branching off stable main branch for enhanced auditability.
